name: herder
description: Shape focused plans, execute them through a persistent Accountant, and observe them in a local graph dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify, create, and execute plans with specialized agents.
interface.longDescription: Herder shapes requested changes and verified findings into focused dependency-aware plans, compiles shared context into immutable snapshots, runs parallel per-plan implementation-review loops through a persistent Accountant control plane, escalates unresolved findings to an independent Judge, integrates verified work transactionally, stores worker-attempt metadata in SQLite, visualizes live execution through a read-only local graph dashboard, and can route plan workers across CLI harnesses through Orca.
defaultPrompt: Grill me one decision at a time, then create a focused validated Herder plan graph for this objective.
Interactively configure and verify Herder role routing for this repository.
Audit this repository and create prioritized Herder plans.
Fire the implementation plans in this repository.
Open a read-only local dashboard for this Herder plan run.
